Usage: astryx integration pack [options]

Deprecated: the old name of `integration verify`

Options:
  --check     Run the check. Required, as before.
  -h, --help  display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  the packed package exposes the same valid contributions
  1  --check is omitted or the tarball is incomplete or invalid

Examples:
  # The old spelling
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration pack --check

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/integration-pack
